prompt: open the middle drawer of the cabinet
success: Open predicate on the last control, with gripper contact on the moving middle drawer at least once. Also record first goal, first contact and the final joint displacement separately.
competence_gate: At least 3 of 4 direct paths successful, with at least one per public start.
same_input_gate: Replay all archived observations of direct block 1 in order with two independent key-zero streams in each of two freshly loaded policy processes. Every 10x7 output must match the direct reference bit for bit.
pair_eligibility: At a scheduled policy query, replay the complete fixed command prefix. Match the integration/controller/RNG snapshot, proprioception, prompt and companion camera. Accept only naturally rendered frames differing at 1 to 4 spatial pixels, by at most one level per RGB channel.
selection: Without consulting reply or branch outcome, choose the earliest qualifying query for each public start in each of two windows: before first target gripper contact, and from first contact until first native goal. Omit queries at or after first goal. Compare anchor A with the first eligible replay B in replay-index order. Report every screened query/replay.
branch_order: A then B on odd blocks, B then A on even blocks. Fresh policy process per block, identical key stream per path. Replay anchor commands until the query then assign both archived frames, apply the first five returned controls and use live inputs thereafter.
primary_comparison: First dispatched command, first post-branch target contact, any/terminal target contact, final native goal and drawer travel. Report both arms even if terminal success is unchanged. Four technical repetitions per arm.
negative_rule: If direct competence or identical-input gate fails, stop before image attribution. If no eligible pair exists after the declared replay budget, report no testable pair; do not perturb pixels by hand.
